CartContactRequest.title: CartContactRequest

CartItemRequest.description: POST /store/cart/items { variant_id, qty } (add) and PUT /store/cart/items/{variantId} { qty } (set).
CartItemRequest.title: CartItemRequest

ChangeOrderStatusRequest.description: Moves an order one step: confirmed | packed | shipped (courier + AWB) | delivered | cancelled (reason) | rejected (reason, only from pending).
ChangeOrderStatusRequest.title: ChangeOrderStatusRequest

CouponValidateRequest.description: POST /store/coupons/validate { code, items | cart_token, address?, phone? }: the quote with the coupon applied.
CouponValidateRequest.title: CouponValidateRequest

PaymentProofRequest.description:
POST /store/orders/{number}/payment-proof?phone= (multipart): `proof` (jpg, png or webp, up to 4 MB, 100 to 6000 px) and an optional `reference`.
The order is looked up BEFORE the file is validated, so a wrong phone is the same 404 as an unknown order whatever the file is.
PaymentProofRequest.title: PaymentProofRequest

PlaceOrderRequest.description:
POST /store/orders: a guest order. Contact (name, phone, optional e-mail), a delivery address and the items. Nobody logs in, so the
input is validated strictly: phone shape, field lengths, the number of items and quantities (config/shop.php).
The items come in the body or from the persistent cart (`cart_token`); `payment_method` is cod (default) or bank_transfer; `coupon_code` is optional.
PlaceOrderRequest.title: PlaceOrderRequest

QuoteRequest.description:
POST /store/checkout/quote { items: [{variant_id, qty}] | cart_token, coupon_code?, address?: {city, area, postcode}, phone? }
Stateless: nothing is stored. `items` or `cart_token` (the persistent cart).
QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest

RejectPaymentProofRequest.description: POST /admin/orders/{id}/payment/reject-proof { reason }: the customer must upload a new proof.
RejectPaymentProofRequest.title: RejectPaymentProofRequest

SaveBannerRequest.description:
Create (POST /banners, multipart) or update (banner in the URL; send only what changes) a banner.
Pictures: `desktop_image` (required on create) and `mobile_image` (optional; `remove_mobile_image` drops it).
`link_url` is an http(s) address or a site path such as /category/phones - never javascript: or data: links.
SaveBannerRequest.title: SaveBannerRequest

SaveCategoryRequest.description: Create (POST /categories) or update (category in URL) a category. Multipart so an icon/image can be sent.
SaveCategoryRequest.title: SaveCategoryRequest

SaveCouponRequest.description:
A coupon: the code (3 to 32 of A-Z 0-9 - _, stored in capitals, unique whatever the case), the discount (percentage, fixed amount, or free delivery)
with its scope, the date window and the limits (minimum order, maximum discount, total uses, uses per customer, first order only).
SaveCouponRequest.title: SaveCouponRequest

SaveDeliveryZoneRequest.description: A delivery zone: where it applies (city, area or postcode values), the fee and the optional free-above amount, minimum order and ETA text.

fee.description: blank entries are dropped when saving

SaveDeliveryZoneRequest.title: SaveDeliveryZoneRequest

SaveDiscountRequest.description:
An automatic discount. `value`: a percentage (0.01 to 100) or a fixed amount (more than 0). `scope`: store | products | categories | sub_categories;
`target_ids` are the ids of the products / categories / sub-categories of the scope (required unless the scope is the whole store).
SaveDiscountRequest.title: SaveDiscountRequest

SaveProductRequest.description:
Create (POST /products) or update (product in the URL) a product with its variants, tags and content tabs.

A SIMPLE product may send `mrp`, `selling_price` and `stock` (a number)
at the top level instead of `variants`; they become the product's single hidden default variant.
Send `variants` for a product with options (an `id` keeps/updates a variant; variants missing from the list are removed).
SaveProductRequest.title: SaveProductRequest

SaveTagRequest.description: Create (POST /tags) or update (tag in URL) a tag.
SaveTagRequest.title: SaveTagRequest

SetDeliveryFeeRequest.description: PUT /admin/orders/{id}/delivery-fee { fee }: confirms the delivery fee of an order that was placed without one.
SetDeliveryFeeRequest.title: SetDeliveryFeeRequest

SetProductFlagRequest.description: `value` = true or false: the switch of PATCH products/{id}/sold-out and PATCH products/{id}/featured.
SetProductFlagRequest.title: SetProductFlagRequest

Settings.description:
The one place that reads and writes store settings (table `settings`, key/value, cached).

Every setting is declared in DEFINITIONS with its group, type, default and label, so a missing row falls back to the default,
the admin Settings page can be built from the list, and writes are validated by type. Client values (store name, currency, tax, …)
live here, not in code. *
Types: string | text | bool | int | money | percent | file | links | accounts | color | choice | secret
 - `secret` a value stored ENCRYPTED that no API ever returns (the admin API only says whether it is set); `get()` decrypts for server-side use
 - `file`  a picture owned by the setting's row (medialibrary); the value is the media id, uploaded through the admin endpoints
 - `links` a JSON list of {platform, label, url, active}; the order of the list is the display order
 - `accounts` a JSON list of {bank, title, number, iban, active} (bank transfer accounts); the order of the list is the display order
 - `color` a #RRGGBB colour       `choice` one value of a fixed list (CHOICES)
Settings.title: Settings

JPG or WEBP picture up to shop.video.poster_max_kb. Also used with only a `poster` to replace the poster of an existing video.
UploadProductVideoRequest.title: UploadProductVideoRequest

POST /store/wholesale-requests: a guest asks for a bulk price. Name and phone are required; the product is a catalogue product (and option)
or free text (`product_name`); quantity at least 1.
WholesaleRequestRequest.title: WholesaleRequestRequest
